summary: Global Mofy AI Limited filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a self-underwritten offering of 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.22 per share, an ordinary primary equity takedown rather than a special situation. The offer price sits far below the Nasdaq closing price of $1.04 on October 30, 2026, and the prior year's range of $0.96 to $97.5 (as adjusted for the June 2026 reverse split) underscores extreme volatility. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics beyond the offering are stated. Watch dilution and post-offering overhang as the arbitrage angle.
